input.title: Technical SEO Expert
input.description:
SeatPick is a profitable, bootstrapped B2C startup

Redefining how fans discover and buy tickets to live events. Think of us as “the Skyscanner for live events” – the world’s #1 ticket search engine and the leading platform for football tickets in the UK and US.

With millions of users annually and growing fast, we’re a product-first, tech-driven team on a mission to disrupt the $300B global ticketing industry. Transparency, simplicity, and trust are at the core of our user experience.

Our advanced SEO systems drive massive, programmatic-scale traffic, and we’re building an AI-first platform to outcompete legacy monopolies using cutting-edge tools.

As we scale, we’re seeking a highly skilled Technical SEO professional to drive growth across hundreds of locales and millions of pages.

What You’ll Be Doing:


 * Perform ongoing technical SEO QA audits across large-scale platforms, identifying and resolving issues before they impact search performance
 * Collaborate closely with development and QA teams to define pre-development SEO requirements, implement fixes, and validate SEO-critical releases
 * Test and validate locale-specific implementations, including hreflang, localized content, URL structures, and region-specific SEO settings
 * Leverage automation tools, scripts, and AI to scale SEO research, reporting, and issue detection
 * Analyze large and diverse datasets to identify trends, gaps, and growth opportunities
 * Conduct technical testing across structured data and schema, site architecture, crawlability, indexability, and site performance
 * Build and maintain scalable reporting frameworks that enable efficient monitoring and action on SEO performance
 * Stay up to date with search engine algorithms, industry trends, and emerging technologies, and recommend innovative technical SEO strategies
   
   

You’re a Fit If You Have:


 * Proven experience in technical SEO, preferably working on large-scale or programmatic websites
 * Hands-on experience crawling large sites and analyzing log files
 * Strong experience conducting technical SEO audits and QA processes across multiple teams
 * Experience ensuring consistent SEO performance and functionality across multiple locales and markets
 * Deep familiarity with SEO tools and data sources such as Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, JetOctopus, Ahrefs, SEMrush, DataforSEO, SQL, and similar platforms
 * Experience integrating AI tools and LLMs (such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) into SEO research, audits, and reporting, and translating insights into actionable plans
 * Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern website architecture
 * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail
 * Proven experience collaborating with development, product, content, and QA teams
 * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical findings into clear and actionable recommendations
 * Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple SEO QA tasks and releases in parallel while maintaining speed and accuracy
 * Strong English communication skills
   
   

Why You’ll Love Working With Us:


 * Opportunity to shape the technical SEO strategy of a high-growth, large-scale global platform
 * Close collaboration with SEO, development, product, and content teams
 * Access to advanced tools, large datasets, and AI-driven workflows to support innovation
 * Competitive salary, benefits, and long-term career growth opportunities
